full_judgment: 2. The relevant facts for disposal of the Rule, inter alio, are that the present petitioner as the plaintiff filed the Title Suit No. 75 of 1994 for partition and recovery of khan possession. The plaint contains that the suit property appertaining to SA khatian No. 2240 of plot No. 5002 and 5003 measuring 38 decimals of land situated at Mouja Palashpole under Satkhira Police Station, District Satkhira was originally owned by Aynuddin, Bhanu Bibi and Abdul Wahid and the SA khatian was published thereof 14 decimals of land was acquired by the Government. The said Aynuddin obtained 16 decimals of land by way of amicable partition and he died leaving behind two sons Amir Ali and Momin Ali and one daughter Moriom Bibi. Momin Ali inherited 7.33 decimals of land and he died leaving behind his wife Fatema Khatun, three daughters namely Hasina Khatun, Sakhina and Moslema (minor) and full brother Amir Ali and full sister Moriom Bibi. The said Fatema Khatun died leaving behind her abovementioned three daughters and also his father and mother. The said Hasina Khatun sold 1 decimal of land from plot No. 5002 on 12-12-1982 in favour of one Md. Nazmul Hassan. The said Sakhina Bibi and Moslema transferred three decimals of land through their uncle Amir Ali, as the guardian from plot No. 5002 to Sahanaz Bilkis by the deed dated 17-1-1983 and the land was mutated in the name of Nazmul Hassan and Sahanaz Bilkis, Both of them transferred total 4 decimals of land to the present plaintiff-petitioner by the registered deed dated 23-5-1993 and the land was mutated in her name and the possession was handed over at the time of purchase. But subsequently, the plaintiff-petitioner was dispossessed from the land measuring 3 decimals. The plaintiff-petitioner requested to the defendant No. 1 for partition of the suit land measuring 4 decimals out of total land measuring 38 decimals which the present defendant opposite-party No. 1 denied.
